# Neat  collaboration  solutions

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

[![Millions of Minds](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Millions-of-Minds-scaled.jpg)](https://vimeo.com/1099739654?share=copy)

Neat designs beautifully simple video devices for Microsoft Teams, Zoom and BYOD, helping to make your meeting experiences the best they can be by ensuring your team always looks, sounds, and feels great.

Neat turns meetings into cinematic productions that encourage freedom of movement and organic conversation.

This more human digital experience positively impacts people’s well-being, motivation, and productivity.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/neat/#contact)

## Real-Time Design with Neat

Experience how to validate your Neat room designs before you build them. No headset or specialty hardware needed!

[Schedule a VR demo](https://avispl.com/neat/#contact)

![Neat’s beautifully simple video devices are easy to install, set up, and use.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Neats-beautifully-simple-video-devices-are-easy-to-install-set-up-and-use.png)

### WHY CUSTOMERS CHOOSE NEAT

In the office, at home, or elsewhere, Neat’s beautifully simple video devices are easy to install, set up, use, and remotely administer via Neat Pulse.

- Purpose-built for Microsoft Teams, Zoom and BYOD
- Addressed a wide spectrum of workspaces
- Neat AI turns meetings into cinematic productions
- Enables engaging hybrid collaboration
- Run business applications with Neat App Hub

![Neat Portfolio 2026](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Neat-Featured-Product-Image.png)

### NEAT DEVICES FOR ALL SPACES AND FUNCTIONS

Neat devices address all types of meeting spaces throughout today’s modern workplace. This includes open plan areas, meeting room of all sizes, privacy booths, social zones, home offices and more.

- Neat Bar Gen 2 delivers extraordinary audio and video for meeting spaces with up to 10 people
- Neat Bar Pro offers outstanding audio and video for larger rooms, supporting up to three screens for spaces with up to 30 people
- Neat Board Pro and Neat Board 50 are elegant, all-in-one touchscreen displays that are wall-mountable or mobile when paired with Neat’s adaptive stand
- Neat Center is a companion device that extends the audio and video coverage around the room

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/neat/#contact)

##### CERTIFIED:

Neat devices are certified for Microsoft Teams, Zoom, BYOD and soon Google Meet.

##### FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS:

Neat Symmetry presents everyone in the meeting room equally up close, whether they’re sitting, standing or moving about the room.

##### SIMPLE SETUP:

Everything you need to get your Neat device up and running fast is in the box, including all mounts and cables.

##### APPS GALORE:

Neat App Hub brings all the essential apps you rely on in your daily workflows directly to your Neat devices.

##### NO DISTRACTIONS:

Neat Boundary removes the worry of being distracted by other activities happening around you.

##### REMOTE ADMINISTRATION:

Neat Pulse gives you a remote view into all of your Neat devices, including current status, room occupancy and air quality, scheduled updates and more.
